verdict.rationale: Bento's first-party docs describe an official CLI with 50+ commands covering subscriber search, CSV import, tags and fields, events and purchases, broadcasts and sequences, transactional email, and templates. Its Skills guidance explicitly tells AI agents when to use the CLI alongside MCP, SDK, and n8n. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as described, and evidence of installation and authentication details.
